verdict.rationale: Fenwick Labs names firm-built tools for "automated generation of incorporation documents for new startups" and "online term-sheet generation", so the firm has its own document-automation capability. Only that single list-style mention exists; nothing shows founders can assemble documents themselves online, and the Startup Resource Center describes articles and checklists rather than interactive assembly. missing for 10: evidence the tools are self-serve for founders rather than lawyer-operated, a description of the interactive assembly workflow, which documents can be completed online, access terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
